_comment: Written by scripts/econ/models.mjs (edit that, not this). Player models: fixed named modules (docs/parts-redesign.md). `legacy`: the family each legacy function migrates to.

models.name: Pip
models.description: The starter gun: three reliable amber shells a second, and no tricks. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Pip
guide.blurb: The reliable starter

models.name: Hammer
models.description: The breacher: one slow, heavy, armour-piercing slug a second, for 88. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Hammer
guide.blurb: The breacher

augment.name: Breaching charge
augment.say: its slug punches one grade deeper and bursts inside

models.name: Twinlink
models.description: A paired autoloader turret: a burst of eight heavy rounds, then a pause to reload. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Twinlink
guide.blurb: Paired autoloader turret

augment.name: Tracer lock
augment.say: a tight stream twice as fast, harder-hitting, that reaches much further

models.name: Longbarrel
models.description: The sniper: it charges while you hold and fires itself at full, one telegraphed shot that picks a part off. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Longbarrel
guide.blurb: The sniper

augment.name: Penetrator
augment.say: its round goes on through two more ships

models.name: Bastion
models.description: The ship-killer double tap: two huge, slow cannonballs you can dodge, then a long wait. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Bastion
guide.blurb: The ship-killer double tap

augment.name: Shatter
augment.say: each ball bursts in a 200 blast

models.name: Rattler
models.description: The steady hose: a stream of yellow shells, four a second, at a fixed rhythm. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Rattler
guide.blurb: The steady hose

models.name: Chainsaw
models.description: The minigun: it spins up from two and a half shots a second to seven and a half while you hold the trigger, and is useless on a tap. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Chainsaw
guide.blurb: The minigun

augment.name: Incendiary belt
augment.say: every round sets the part it hits burning

models.name: Stinger
models.description: The marksman SMG: six fast, accurate needles in a burst, then a pause to reload. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Stinger
guide.blurb: The marksman SMG

models.name: Burst
models.description: The sky-filler: a canister shell that bursts where you aim, or sooner when it passes near a target, throwing fragments over 170 units. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Burst
guide.blurb: The sky-filler

models.name: Cloudmaker
models.description: The wall you place: four shells that burst where you aim, or sooner when they pass near a target, throwing fragments over 250 units. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Cloudmaker
guide.blurb: The wall you place

augment.name: Wide burst
augment.say: bursts half again as wide and 60% harder

models.name: Lobber
models.description: Artillery that lands where you click: one shell every second and a half, lobbed over everything to burst at your cursor (out to 2,640) in a 220 blast. Forty shells a crate. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Lobber
guide.blurb: Artillery that lands where you click

models.name: Quake
models.description: The walking barrage: a salvo of three shells every three seconds that land at 70%, 100% and 130% of your aim distance, a quarter second apart, each a 260 blast. It covers a lane, not a point. Uses three rounds a salvo. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Quake
guide.blurb: The walking barrage

models.name: Glint
models.description: The long pulse: it charges for 1.8 s, then a 1.4 s pulse peaking at 96 damage reaches 5,100 units. Time it; 27 E a pulse. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Glint
guide.blurb: The long pulse

models.name: Cutter
models.description: The welding torch: a short held beam that burns deeper the longer it stays on one part, 60 rising to 150 damage a second over 1.5 s (it starts over if it slips off). 32 E a second. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Cutter
guide.blurb: The welding torch

models.name: Searchlight
models.description: The spotter: a thin beam that reaches furthest and barely hurts, but what it lights takes 20% more damage from everyone for 2 s after. 15 E a second. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Searchlight
guide.blurb: The spotter

augment.name: Sear
augment.say: its marking beam burns twice as hot

models.name: Strobe
models.description: Steady shield pressure: a burst of 2 bolts every half second, 14 damage each, 1.6 times against shields and 0.6 against hull. 6 E a burst. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Strobe
guide.blurb: Steady shield pressure

models.name: Overpulse
models.description: The shield shredder: a clip of 6 fast bolts at 6 a second, 13 damage each, then a 1 s reload drawing 36 E. 1.9 times against shields and half against hull. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Overpulse
guide.blurb: The shield shredder

models.name: Dart
models.description: Lock and forget: a missile every couple of seconds that homes on the ship nearest your cursor, 30 damage and a 120 blast. Twenty-four missiles a crate. Point defence kills it in one hit. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Dart
guide.blurb: Lock and forget

models.name: Swarm
models.description: The ripple that floods point defence: a pair of small rockets every three-quarters of a second, steady for as long as you hold, spreading and then converging on the ship nearest your cursor. Each is 10 damage and a 60 blast and dies to one point-defence hit. One round a pair. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Swarm
guide.blurb: The ripple that floods point defence

models.name: Hammerhead
models.description: The steered warhead: a slow, heavy missile, 105 damage and a 150 blast. While you hold fire it flies toward your cursor; let go and it flies straight. Point defence needs two hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Hammerhead
guide.blurb: The steered warhead

models.name: Needle
models.description: The cheap rail: a long thin slug that goes through two ships. It fires slugs from the hold and needs no power. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Needle
guide.blurb: The cheap rail

models.name: Coilgun
models.description: The rail shotgun: three heavy slugs in a tight cone, a finisher for close range that is spent past 2,700. It throws its own slugs for 14 E a shot, so it needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Coilgun
guide.blurb: The rail shotgun

augment.name: Choke
augment.say: a tight, heavy pattern that carries twice as far

models.name: Spear
models.description: The capital rail: one slug every couple of seconds that goes through three ships at full damage, a ring of shock at each. It costs 120 E a shot and needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Spear
guide.blurb: The capital rail

models.name: Hush
models.description: Switches one ship off: an orb that bursts on its fuse or beside a ship, and 2 s of dead engines and guns. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Hush
guide.blurb: Switch one ship off

models.name: Blackout
models.description: Hold to charge, then it fires itself: an orb that bursts where you aimed, or beside a ship, for a wide 2.8 s blackout. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Blackout
guide.blurb: The charged area blackout

models.name: Spark
models.description: A fast blue bolt that flies out to 4,000 and leaps to 3 more ships near what it hits, weaker each hop. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Spark
guide.blurb: The chain zap

augment.name: Storm coil
augment.say: its arc leaps to six targets, further apart

models.name: Tesla
models.description: Hold to keep zapping, five times a second: each zap leaps to 5 more ships nearby, weaker each hop. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Tesla
guide.blurb: The held storm

models.name: Eel
models.description: The stalker: a slow, fat torpedo that creeps after its prey, 420 damage straight through shields and a 90 blast. Six torpedoes a crate, one every four seconds. Point defence needs three hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Eel
guide.blurb: The stalker

models.name: Leviathan
models.description: The fight-ender: a huge torpedo, 560 damage straight through shields and a 120 blast, one every three seconds. It flies straight at a steady pace and does not home, and arms half a second after launch. One round a shot. Point defence needs five hits. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Leviathan
guide.blurb: The fight-ender

models.name: Lance
models.description: The heavy held beam: 210 damage a second at 500 units after a 0.3 s windup, piercing, 20% more against plating. 90 E a second; short of power it sputters. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Lance
guide.blurb: The heavy held beam

models.name: Rustjaw's Hive
models.description: A nest that regrows: it holds eight seekers and looses them four at a time, a tenth of a second apart, each homing on a different one of the four ships nearest your cursor. One grows back every three-quarters of a second, drawing a little power. Each is 10 damage and a 70 blast, and dies to one point-defence hit. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Frostbite Lance
models.description: The freeze beam: a held beam out to 760 that burns 95 a second. The ship it touches is slowed, 40% less thrust and turning, while lit and 0.7 s after. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Cinder Bloom
models.description: The arsonist: a shell every 1.2 s for 16 damage, and the part it hits burns for 22 a second over 5 s, the fire spreading to its neighbours. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Prism Splitter
models.description: The splitter: a crystal bolt every 1.6 s that splits where your cursor is into five 11-damage shards in a 40 degree fan. You choose where the fan opens. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Phase Cannon
models.description: The ghost round: a slow 70-damage round every 2.2 s that flies through rock, wrecks and shields, hits the hull directly, and carries on through two ships. Fixed: aim with the ship.

models.name: Singularity Launcher
models.description: The black hole: 210 power a shot, one every 7 s. A slow orb flies to your cursor and stops there, pulls every ship within 900 toward it for 3.8 s, then collapses in a 300 blast for 140. Turret: turns to your aim.

models.name: Ion Drive
models.description: Efficient and steady, with a low top speed.

guide.name: Ion Drive
guide.blurb: Efficient and steady, with a low top speed

models.name: Vernier
models.description: A cheap little thruster for corner push. It has no boost: boosting gives it no extra thrust and no extra drain.

guide.name: Vernier
guide.blurb: A cheap little thruster for corner push. It has no boost: boosting gives it no extra thrust and no extra drain

models.name: Afterburner
models.description: Weak at cruise, a huge burst when boosting. Best with a Drive Cell touching it.

guide.name: Afterburner
guide.blurb: Weak at cruise, a huge burst when boosting. Best with a Drive Cell touching it

models.name: Torch
models.description: Brutal thrust at full power all the time, and a brutal drain. It has no boost: nothing is held back to give.

guide.name: Torch
guide.blurb: Brutal thrust at full power all the time, and a brutal drain. It has no boost: nothing is held back to give

models.name: Plasma Drive
models.description: The balanced main engine.

guide.name: Plasma Drive
guide.blurb: The balanced main engine

models.name: Drift Sail
models.description: Near-free cruising, never in a hurry.

guide.name: Drift Sail
guide.blurb: Near-free cruising, never in a hurry

models.name: Fusion Torch
models.description: The long-haul racer: fast, and faster still.

guide.name: Fusion Torch
guide.blurb: The long-haul racer: fast, and faster still

models.name: Cell Reactor
models.description: The starter generator. It explodes when destroyed.

guide.name: Cell Reactor
guide.blurb: The starter generator

models.name: Isotope Pile
models.description: A weak generator, but tough, and it never explodes.

guide.name: Isotope Pile
guide.blurb: A weak generator, but tough, and it never explodes

models.name: Fusion Plant
models.description: A heavy plant with plenty of power, and a big blast.

guide.name: Fusion Plant
guide.blurb: A heavy plant with plenty of power, and a big blast

models.name: Overclock Reactor
models.description: The most power for its size: fragile, and the biggest blast.

guide.name: Overclock Reactor
guide.blurb: The most power for its size

models.name: Battery
models.description: Adds to the ship's pool on a powered network: holds 200 and gives it quickly.

guide.name: Battery
guide.blurb: Adds to the ship's pool on a powered network

models.name: Capacitor
models.description: Touching Capacitors form a bank that feeds the guns, beams, miners and Flash Screen it touches before the ship does; it does not feed engines.

guide.name: Capacitor
guide.blurb: Touching Capacitors form a bank that feeds the guns, beams, miners and Flash Screen it touches before the ship does; it does not feed engines

models.name: Drive Cell
models.description: Touching Drive Cells form a bank that feeds the engines and Burst Strafers it touches before the ship does; it does not feed guns.

guide.name: Drive Cell
guide.blurb: Touching Drive Cells form a bank that feeds the engines and Burst Strafers it touches before the ship does; it does not feed guns

models.name: Heavy Bank
models.description: A deep, heavy battery for the ship's pool: holds a lot, but gives it slowly.

guide.name: Heavy Bank
guide.blurb: A deep, heavy battery for the ship's pool

models.name: Mining Laser
models.description: A pulsed cutter that takes ore from rock, and a poor weapon.

guide.name: Mining Laser
guide.blurb: A pulsed cutter that takes ore from rock, and a poor weapon

models.name: Bore
models.description: A heavy cutter that breaks harder rock than a mining laser.

guide.name: Bore
guide.blurb: A heavy cutter that breaks harder rock than a mining laser

models.name: Demolition Launcher
models.description: Fires mining charges (30 a crate, one every 2 seconds) that stick to rock, blink for a second, then blow it open. Harmless to ships. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Demolition Launcher
guide.blurb: Fires mining charges (30 a crate, one every 2 seconds) that stick to rock, blink for a second, then blow it open

models.name: Siphon
models.description: Drinks gas from gas pockets and sends it back to the ship.

guide.name: Siphon
guide.blurb: Drinks gas from gas pockets and sends it back to the ship

models.name: Scanner
models.description: A quick short sweep that reads rocks and finds seams.

guide.name: Scanner
guide.blurb: A quick short sweep that reads rocks and finds seams

models.name: Long-Range Array
models.description: A slow sweep that reaches twice as far as a scanner.

guide.name: Long-Range Array
guide.blurb: A slow sweep that reaches twice as far as a scanner

models.name: Constructor
models.description: Builds structures piece by piece.

guide.name: Constructor
guide.blurb: Builds structures piece by piece

models.name: Deflector
models.description: The standard shield, which soaks damage before the hull and refills 8 a second per cell after 3 seconds unhit.

guide.name: Deflector
guide.blurb: The standard shield, which soaks damage before the hull and refills 8 a second per cell after 3 seconds unhit

models.name: Flicker Screen
models.description: A thin, cheap shield that refills 20 a second per cell after only 1 second unhit.

guide.name: Flicker Screen
guide.blurb: A thin, cheap shield that refills 20 a second per cell after only 1 second unhit

models.name: Bulwark Projector
models.description: A deep shield that soaks an alpha strike but refills only 5 a second per cell after 4 seconds unhit.

guide.name: Bulwark Projector
guide.blurb: A deep shield that soaks an alpha strike but refills only 5 a second per cell after 4 seconds unhit

models.name: Jump Coil
models.description: More jump drive for a bigger hull.

guide.name: Jump Coil
guide.blurb: More jump drive for a bigger hull

models.name: Heavy Coil
models.description: A dense coil with more jump drive per cell that also cuts the jump cooldown by a fifth.

guide.name: Heavy Coil
guide.blurb: A dense coil with more jump drive per cell that also cuts the jump cooldown by a fifth

models.name: Reactive Armour
models.description: Plate that blunts small fast hits, so it beats streams of fire.

guide.name: Reactive Armour
guide.blurb: Plate that blunts small fast hits, so it beats streams of fire

models.name: Spaced Plating
models.description: Layered plate with room between that takes half damage from blasts.

guide.name: Spaced Plating
guide.blurb: Layered plate with room between that takes half damage from blasts

models.name: Pulse Dynamo
models.description: Puts 10 a second into each Capacitor or Drive Cell bank it touches. It needs no wires and powers nothing itself.

guide.name: Pulse Dynamo
guide.blurb: Puts 10 a second into each Capacitor or Drive Cell bank it touches

models.name: Flash Screen
models.description: A shield with no slow refill that returns whole 4 seconds after it breaks, or at once for 4 E a point from a Capacitor bank touching it.

guide.name: Flash Screen
guide.blurb: A shield with no slow refill that returns whole 4 seconds after it breaks, or at once for 4 E a point from a Capacitor bank touching it

models.name: Rail Driver
models.description: The semi-automatic rifle: a clip of four heavy shots, one a click (as fast as you can click, up to five a second; a second Rail Driver takes alternate shots, skipping one that is reloading), then it reloads itself in a second and a half for 48 E, from its bank first. It needs no ammo. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Rail Driver
guide.blurb: The semi-automatic rifle

augment.name: Coil boost
augment.say: half again the damage, a third faster

models.name: Repair Beam
models.description: Mends 42 HP a second into the friendly part its beam lands on (range 520, 28 power a second): hold fire with it on a party member or an ally. It can't mend your own ship, a destroyed part or a shield, and does nothing to an enemy. Turret: turns to your aim.

guide.name: Repair Beam
guide.blurb: Mends 42 HP a second into the friendly part its beam lands on (range 520, 28 power a second)

models.name: Point Defence Turret
models.description: Shoots down incoming missiles, torpedoes, mortar shells and seekers on its own: 5 shots a second out to 560, 2 power a shot. One hit kills a missile, mortar shell or seeker; a Hammerhead takes 2, an Eel 3, a Leviathan 5. It never fires at ships, and a boss's rings of shots are yours to dodge. Turret: aims itself.

guide.name: Point Defence Turret
guide.blurb: Shoots down incoming missiles, torpedoes, mortar shells and seekers on its own

models.name: Burst Strafer
models.description: A dodge thruster: a hard fifth-of-a-second burst away from its nozzle, ready again in under half a second, and a lot of energy every time. Fit them facing different ways to dodge any way. It draws from a Drive Cell bank touching it first. No push at all for cruising.

guide.name: Burst Strafer
guide.blurb: A dodge thruster

models.name: Tow Beam
models.description: Latches onto a wreck, debris or a loot pod and drags it on a tether to a station to salvage, and never takes hold of a working ship.

guide.name: Tow Beam
guide.blurb: Latches onto a wreck, debris or a loot pod and drags it on a tether to a station to salvage, and never takes hold of a working ship

models.name: Conduit
models.description: A power line: it passes power between the parts it touches, up to 200 a second, and holds only 10 itself.

guide.name: Conduit
guide.blurb: A power line

models.name: Diode
models.description: A one-way power line: power only flows out of its front, into the part there, up to 200 a second; the other parts touching it can only feed it. Its front must touch a part.

guide.name: Diode
guide.blurb: A one-way power line

models.name: Gyro
models.description: A reaction wheel: it adds turning force anywhere on the hull, with no push of its own, and draws power only while turning. Heavier than plain hull.

guide.name: Gyro
guide.blurb: A reaction wheel

models.name: Heavy Gyro
models.description: A big reaction wheel for big ships: it adds a lot of turning force anywhere on the hull, with no push of its own, and draws power only while turning. Heavy.

guide.name: Heavy Gyro
guide.blurb: A big reaction wheel for big ships

models.name: Joiner Bank
models.description: A battery that joins two lines into one: it takes 40 a second at each of its two back ports and gives 90 out of its front left. Holds 300.

guide.name: Joiner Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that joins two lines into one

models.name: Splitter Bank
models.description: A battery that splits one line into two: it takes 80 a second at its back left and gives 45 out of each front port. Holds 300.

guide.name: Splitter Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that splits one line into two

models.name: Elbow Joiner Bank
models.description: A battery that joins two lines into one around a corner: it takes 40 a second at each of its two back ports and gives 90 out of its right end (flip it for the left). Holds 300.

guide.name: Elbow Joiner Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that joins two lines into one around a corner

models.name: End Joiner Bank
models.description: A battery that joins two lines from its two ends: it takes 40 a second at its left end and at its right end, and gives 90 out of its front left. Holds 300.

guide.name: End Joiner Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that joins two lines from its two ends

models.name: Cross Joiner Bank
models.description: A battery that joins a line from its back and one from its front into one: it takes 40 a second at its back left and its front left, and gives 90 out of its right end. Holds 300.

guide.name: Cross Joiner Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that joins a line from its back and one from its front into one

models.name: Elbow Splitter Bank
models.description: A battery that splits one line in two, one straight on and one round a corner: it takes 80 a second at its back left and gives 45 out of its front left and 45 out of its right end. Holds 300.

guide.name: Elbow Splitter Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that splits one line in two, one straight on and one round a corner

models.name: Tee Splitter Bank
models.description: A battery that splits a line from its end to its front and back: it takes 80 a second at its left end and gives 45 out of its front left and 45 out of its back left. Holds 300.

guide.name: Tee Splitter Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that splits a line from its end to its front and back

models.name: End Splitter Bank
models.description: A battery that splits one line out of its two ends: it takes 80 a second at its back left and gives 45 out of its left end and 45 out of its right end. Holds 300.

guide.name: End Splitter Bank
guide.blurb: A battery that splits one line out of its two ends

models.name: Surge Cell
models.description: A fast cell: it takes 120 a second and pours 300, so a gun that shuts its ports after a shot gets it all back the moment they open. Holds 120.

guide.name: Surge Cell
guide.blurb: A fast cell

models.name: Corner Conduit
models.description: A power line that turns: in at the back, out to the right (flip it for the left), up to 200 a second.

guide.name: Corner Conduit
guide.blurb: A power line that turns

models.name: Combiner
models.description: Joins a feed to a power line: a pipe at its left side brings a material, and the line out of its front carries it with the power, along conduits (a battery stops it) into a gun or engine that takes it. Tough.

guide.name: Combiner
guide.blurb: Joins a feed to a power line

models.name: Passthrough
models.description: A power line with a pipe through it, side to side: the one way a feed crosses a line.

guide.name: Passthrough
guide.blurb: A power line with a pipe through it, side to side

models.name: Feed Pipe
models.description: A pipe: it joins tanks, Selectors, Combiners and guns with feed inputs on every side. It carries no power.

guide.name: Feed Pipe
guide.blurb: A pipe

models.name: Selector
models.description: Two feeds in (left and right), one out (front): the pilot switches which one passes (Y). What is already in the lines and buffers runs out first.

guide.name: Selector
guide.blurb: Two feeds in (left and right), one out (front)

models.name: Overcharge Tank
models.description: A tank of Overcharge: Harder hits and half the discharge, for 40% more power a shot. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Overcharge Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Overcharge

models.name: Coolant Tank
models.description: A tank of Coolant: Half the discharge and rest, 15% softer hits. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Coolant Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Coolant

models.name: Damping Gel Tank
models.description: A tank of Damping Gel: A heavy gun needs half the floor, a quarter slower. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Damping Gel Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Damping Gel

models.name: Flux Salts Tank
models.description: A tank of Flux Salts: 30% less power a shot, 15% softer hits. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Flux Salts Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Flux Salts

models.name: Accelerant Tank
models.description: A tank of Accelerant: 30% faster fire for a quarter more power a shot, and a higher floor. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Accelerant Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Accelerant

models.name: Lens Fluid Tank
models.description: A tank of Lens Fluid: A beam burns a quarter less and hits a tenth softer, resting longer. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Lens Fluid Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Lens Fluid

models.name: Catalyst Tank
models.description: A tank of Catalyst: An engine burns 40% less for 15% less thrust. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Catalyst Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Catalyst

models.name: Reaction Mass Tank
models.description: A tank of Reaction Mass: 40% more thrust for the same burn; a Reaction Thruster runs on it. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Reaction Mass Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Reaction Mass

models.name: Burst Gel Tank
models.description: A tank of Burst Gel: Boost half again as hard for half the extra burn. Holds 120; pipes join it on every side. It is refilled in the hangar.

guide.name: Burst Gel Tank
guide.blurb: A tank of Burst Gel

models.name: Reaction Thruster
models.description: An engine built for feed: a weak push on power alone, five times that on Reaction Mass piped to its left side (1.2 a second while thrusting). Power stays with the guns; the price is tanks and space.

guide.name: Reaction Thruster
guide.blurb: An engine built for feed

models.name: Slurry Cannon
models.description: The two-input gun: power at its back left and its own feed input at its back right, and it fires only with a material in it: a heavy slug every 0.7 s that hits like a Hammer. Overcharge, Accelerant or Flux Salts. Fixed: aim with the ship.

guide.name: Slurry Cannon
guide.blurb: The two-input gun

models.name: Field Fabricator
models.description: Builds and repairs parts from your hold while you fly, up to Mk II, drawing 40 a second while it works. One per ship.

guide.name: Field Fabricator
guide.blurb: Builds and repairs parts from your hold while you fly, up to Mk II, drawing 40 a second while it works

models.name: Fabrication Bay
models.description: Builds and repairs parts from your hold 1.6 times as fast as a Field Fabricator, up to Mk III, drawing 70 a second while it works. One per ship.

guide.name: Fabrication Bay
guide.blurb: Builds and repairs parts from your hold 1

models.name: Assembly Forge
models.description: Builds and repairs any part from your hold 2.5 times as fast as a Field Fabricator, drawing 110 a second while it works. One per ship.

guide.name: Assembly Forge
guide.blurb: Builds and repairs any part from your hold 2

models.name: Field Refiner
models.description: Refines ore in your hold while you fly, up to Mk II materials, at 0.4 of a station's pace, drawing 20 a second while it works. One per ship.

guide.name: Field Refiner
